serviceDescription: RTBM LMP contour service is a product of Southwest Power Pool(SPP), providing access to the RTBM price contours. Service updates every 5 minutes with the latest market data for RTBM. Contour is created based on LMP values at each PNODE in the Southwest Power Pool footprint.
